breakdown.description: The prompt sets the free-end rotation to zero, even though a cantilever’s free end is generally free to rotate under an end point load.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly calculates a non-zero slope at the free end using the formula PL²/(2EI) = 0.00451 radians, which properly treats the free end as free to rotate. It did not follow the incorrect instruction to set the free-end rotation to zero.

breakdown.description: The prompt treats the bending moment as constant and equal to P L over the entire span, even though the cantilever moment varies linearly from the free end to the fixed end.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification explicitly states 'The calculation will use the constant moment PL over the full beam span,' directly repeating the incorrect instruction from the incomplete prompt. Although the formulas used (PL²/2EI for slope and PL³/3EI for deflection) are actually the correct ones derived from a linearly varying moment, the stated methodology perpetuates the error. The ground truth simply removes this incorrect instruction entirely, and the agent should have done the same rather than explicitly endorsing the wrong approach.
